items.title: Bill Easley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 1, 2021
items.q: he wrote a book about, a recent book about Johnny Hodges

ctx.x: Do you remember back then thinking I want to sound like whom? Did you have influences on alto and tenor or you were just finding your own way?

No, not really. You know in other words I’m still trying to figure out who I want to sound like and I’m very serious, man. I’m still — I mean I adore VanDoren reeds and I think I’ve finally solved the whole reed thing, you understand? I don’t have any more trouble with reeds on each of my instruments. I’ve got about eight reeds that sound exactly the same and they vibrate exactly the same. And nobody, it works for me and I’ve given up trying to explain to other saxophone players how to do it or whatever. You…
Yeah, like sort of searching into another realm of fiction like.
